description: Fires only late in the game when the board is nearly full: from about 34 stones when the player to move moved first (even stone count), and only from about 39 stones otherwise. Stronger when the last move was in column 6 (or 0), weaker after a move in columns 2-4, and weaker when columns 3, 4 or 6 still have open space; an open column 2 (or 0/1) helps. Never fires before ~30 stones, regardless of tactics.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero moves move probabilities by at most ~5 points on 3 positions.
notes: Layer-0 unit; mostly a stone-count (ply) detector with parity sawtooth. Best dev F1 0.663 (P 0.54, R 0.86, AUROC 0.92), sim share 0.09. Ply-only rule F1 0.585. Column-composition effects are real (single-stone swaps ~0.2) but non-additive (filling col 2 kills it), so a linear per-column model miscalibrated; a stronger open-col-2 bonus raised AUROC to 0.96 but over-fired (F1 0.62). Synthesis best 2.84 < dev max 2.976. Synthesis replaced after orchestrator audit: 4 earlier sequences (column-by-column fills) completed a four mid-game; new ones are four-free random interleavings (cols 0,1,3-6 full, 2 stones in col 2, last move col 6), best 2.939 < dev max 2.976.
